en: "<ManagerName1> has accepted an offer to become manager of <TeamName2> today putting an end to recent speculation over the position. After taking his place in the <TeamName2> hot seat, <ManagerName1> was quick to point out to the press his delight in securing the role and unveil his plans for the future of <TeamName2>. ""I'm a very ambitious manager and will be looking at bringing major trophies back to this country"" said a confident <ManagerName1>. ""Some people might think I'm crazy but I've set my sights on the World Cup and up to now what I've wanted I've got."""

"Despite a great personal performance on his return from injury, a downbeat <FullPlayerName> was disappointed that his <TeamName> side went down to defeat against <TeamName2>. ""It was tough out there today, they were quicker than us and out thought us too."" he commented. ""Naturally I was pleased to be fit and be selected, but when you tell me I played well I'm not really paying attention as we lost as a team today and I was a member of that team. So I'm thinking what could I have done better. That's the only way we can all improve together"" he thoughtfully mused."

It may only be the early stages of the season, but it's never too early for a top of the table clash between bitter rivals, and that's what we've got coming up next as the leaders <TeamName3> take on the team in second place, <TeamName4>. It's too early to say for certain that both of these teams will be around at the end of the season as title contenders, but they have both made a great start to the season, and will be fancied to be there or thereabouts. Meanwhile let's look forward to a cracking game of football, and hope it's one we remember for a long time to come.

"%1s has made a decision to stay with %2s for another season, and by the sounds of it, it was an easy decision to make.\r\n""I can't see myself playing for any other team right now."" He said in an interview yesterday.  The club Manager told the press that ""we are glad to have him stay"".\r\nWhen we asked %1s why he didn't want to play somewhere else, he stated ""I love this team, everyone here has been like family to me, and we have the greatest fans in the world"".  Local %2s supporters have always thought of %1s as a great athlete and are happy that he is staying."

It may only be the early stages of the season, but it's never too early for an exciting encounter near the top of the table, and that's what we've got coming up next as the leaders <TeamName3> take on one of the chasing pack, <TeamName4>. It's too early to say for certain that both of these teams will be around at the end of the season as title contenders, but they have both made a great start to the season, and will be fancied to be there or thereabouts. Meanwhile let's look forward to a cracking game of football, and hope it's one we remember for a long time to come.

The situation surrounding the future of <FullPlayerName> took another twist last night as the club's Chief Executive was seen flying out of the country. He refused to answer questions as he hurried through the airport and his destination was unclear. The player's agent was not returning calls and the player himself didn't turn up to training. One of his team mates who wished to remain anonymous did however make a comment as he left the training ground. He suggested that the other players were stunned at what was happening and were unsure if he would be leaving or not.

"%1s's agent has revealed that %4s have approached %3s in an attempt to sign the prolific %6s, who finished last year as the league's top scorer with %2s goals. \r\n%4s representatives were cautious when asked about a potential move for the %5s-yr old striker, stating only that ""It is no secret that %1s will be one of the most precious commodities in this transfer market after his performance last season. At this moment we are looking at several options to improve our attack and given his current form, it would be silly for us to deny that we are interested in him."""

<TeamName1> host their bitter rivals <TeamName2> in a big top of the table clash that will put one team in pole position for the run in to the league title. TV audiences around the country will be eagerly awaiting the clash of the top two in the division, and most pundits think this game will live up to its billing. <TeamName4> are reported to be hugely confident that they can strike a huge blow to the league leaders, but the top team, <TeamName3>, know that if they can land the three points then they are in a very strong position as the season heads towards the climax.

\n\nWith the media still reflecting on the first two games, the <TeamName>'s manager <UserName>, decided to set things straight. I think that the first two games were terrible. They are not results a squad like this should be getting. However I think it's important for the media and the fans to realise that it's going to mentally strengthen the squad for future fixtures. Having these losses now will help us fix the problem early, rather than hitting this issue further down the line."" With many more fixtures to come the fans will be hoping for more encouraging results."

"<UserName>'s <TeamName> secure their first competitive win and the team looks forward to adding to this good result. <TeamName> provided a solid display to prove to their new manager that they are capable of winning when it matters. <UserName> was pleased with his players performance but recognises that it is only the beginning, ""The guys did a great job in getting a good win today. We've been working hard in training and the composition of the team is looking good. Obviously it's early days but we'll continue to work hard to try and get more results like this one."""

"The media spotlight has been on <PlayerAge> year old <PreferredPos1> player <PlayerName1> with his first international match this year looming. With <TeamName1> soon to face <TeamName2>, <ManagerName1>, has been under pressure to confirm who will and will not play. Fans have been eager to see <PlayerName1> make an international appearance and this would be the ideal time for him to make that showing. ""The lad has performed admirably over recent games domestically so I'm positive that he will be unfazed by the challenges that lay ahead"" added the <TeamName1> manager."

One-man transfer saga, <FullPlayerName>, might yet be on his way from <TeamName>, despite assurances from the club insiders the <PreferredPos1> was happy and going nowhere.\nSpeculation surrounding <PlayerName> has gathered pace since tabloid coverage suggesting he had been struggling to adjust to his new club since his move.\nWhile there is no official word from the club, or the player's representatives, many fans will feel there is no smoke without fire, and will probably remain dubious of the player's intentions until he publicly pledges his allegiance to the team.

Dear Mr. <PlayerName1>,

Your recent confrontations with match officials has not gone unnoticed. We would like you to sort out your temper and from now on to remain under the referee's radar. We would like to think that when you're in the media that it is for good reasons. Remember that you are a representative of the team when you walk out onto the field and it would be wise that you act as such. You are expected to be a good role model to the younger fans and so far you have not lived up our expectations of you. We hope you understand our concern.
Board of Directors

"<ManagerName>, has refused to confirm reports that <FullPlayerName> is unsettled at the club and considering a move away.\nSpeaking at the team's training ground, he said:""I don't want to get in to any speculation about individual players. <PlayerName> is obviously an important part of this squad. The press can speculate as much as they want but, he's a <TeamName> player and he'll be available for selection again in the next game.""\nDespite the manager's reassurances, however, speculation seems set to continue until the club or the player make a definitive statement."

"With a number of names being mentioned it came as a bit of a surprise when %1s announced %2s as their new Manager today.\r\nThe club said that of all the other applicants %2s really stood out despite his lack of experience. A spokesman from the Supporters Club said that the appointment was a ""huge risk"" and that the fans would struggle to warm to a man with no proven track record.\r\nTime will tell if the fans can be won over, but there is no doubting the fact that the club will have given hope to many aspiring managers if the tenure turns out to be a successful one."

\n\nA debut draw followed by a disappointing defeat in the previous game will leave fans wondering whether international management was the right move for <UserName>. In the last game they struggled and could not grab a victory against a team that were far more clinical in the final third. Encouraged by the positives taken from his debut game <UserName> looks to the challenge of <TeamName2> knowing that a win could send forth the winds of change that the nation desires. Another loss could forecast a gloomy outlook for the man only installed in the hot seat two games ago.

"\n\nFans were left with many positives and many negatives to look back on in the first game with players leaving the manager a lot to contemplate ahead of the next game. ""We were sloppy in areas all over the pitch and this is not acceptable. The players need to start showing their ability as there are teams who I consider to be strong in the fixtures ahead. If they smell blood then they will attack"" were the words of the <TeamName> manager. With not long left until the second game the team will surely have to tighten up and correct their errors on the training pitch."

Good defenders are worth their weight in gold to teams facing a relegation fight and <FullPlayerName3> is likely to prove a key member of the <TeamName> squad as they fight for survival in the division this year.
But keeping goals out is only a part of the equation and forward <FullPlayerName1> will be required to demonstrate plenty of goal-grabbing technique if the club is to preserve its status. Both players will also often depend on the ability of midfielder <FullPlayerName2> as they strive to avoid the drop.
%2s

"With the <CompetitionName> Final looming over the football season, <ManagerName> has nothing but praise for his opponents <TeamName2>. ""They are an amazing team, and we'll be struggling to keep up with them since they look the stronger team on paper."" he said. ""I'm sure their manager has got them nicely relaxed, not worrying too much about the massive occasion.  I know the fans don't like each other too much, but I hope they can put that to one side and enjoy a great day out. I just hope that we can play a part in a great final and help to serve up a cracking game."""

"%2s have confirmed that they have agreed to let %8s go to %1s in exchange for %9s and a transfer fee rumored to be around %4s.\r\n%3s has signed a %6d year deal and will be unveiled in front of the press and fans at the club's training ground later today.\r\nAs for %2s, the move must have puzzled a few fans, as it is not clear how effective %7s will be at his new club. The manager was quick to address the media regarding the move and silence any doubters, stating ""We would have never accepted this deal if we didn't think that he would be a great addition to our club."""

"With the new season coming, %2s has signed %1s to help them out and he is keen to get started.\r\n""This is such a great opportunity, I can't wait to get out there and show them all what I can do"" was the statement %1s made. When asked if he thought this season would be a successful one, he answered that most players are optimistic about the season ahead and that if they ""get off to a good start"" anything can happen.\r\nWhether the fans share the player's optimism remains to be seen, but it seems like this could well end up being a season to remember for all of them."

"In the run up to the big <CompetitionName> tie, <ManagerName> has been speaking to the press about his opponents <TeamName2>. ""They are a quality team, there's no doubt about that."" he said to begin. ""It's quite an honour to be playing them at this stage of the competition, and I'd have to say they are a much stronger team than us, so I just hope we can live with them and give the fans and viewers a cracking cup tie. I'm sure both teams will play in the spirit of the competition since that's the way <ManagerName2> likes the game to be played after all"" he continued."

"<PlayerName1> has been officially sent on loan to <TeamName1> from <TeamName2>. ""I'm excited about getting the chance to play more football. Hopefully this will help me establish myself at a club"" added <PlayerName1>. <ManagerName1> also was keen to comment on the player's arrival ""I'm very happy to have him here. He's going to be a big help to us and our plans. I just hope he enjoys his time here."" With the club known to be paying, what to them is a substantial amount for his services, fans will be hoping that he lives up to the price tag that hangs around his neck."

"<ManagerName> is still adamant that <PlayerName> will improve. ""Everyone goes through a rough spell, not only players, but managers also go through it."" He went on to add ""His current form does concern me. I would be silly not to be concerned. However, I have faith that things will get better as time goes on."" <PlayerName> responded to his manager's comments with ""I know people expect a lot from me, so it's frustrating when I can't give them what they want. I'll continue to work hard both on and off the pitch and hopefully I can do <ManagerName> and the fans proud."""

"Speaking to the press ahead of the game with <TeamName2>, <ManagerName> was happy to talk about the thrashing his team took at the hands of their opponents.\n""We took a bit of a hiding the last time we played this lot, so the lads have got plenty of motivation to put right what happened on that day. I thought we did alright to be honest, we just dropped our concentration a couple of times, and they got lucky too. The lads are looking great in training this week, and I can see that they are well up for this one and looking to overturn that poor result we had previously."""

"It seems after a string of dismal performances that <FullPlayerName1> has finally met with the <TeamName1> manager's chopping block in a move that may not have been a surprise to everyone. ""I wish him all the best in his future endeavours"", began an unapologetic <ManagerName1>, ""But to ensure the standards here at the club do not falter I must ensure that we do not rely on individuals that do not contribute to the teams success."" It's unknown who will replace the stagnant <PreferredPos1> but <ManagerName1> hopes the move might be the key to finding their next talisman."

"<FullPlayerName> spoke out last night about his mistreatment at <TeamName>. Speaking at the opening of a new activity centre for disadvantaged children, the <PreferredPos1> had this to say.\n""I've been really frustrated this season that I'm not getting into the team, and over the past few weeks the situation has come to a head. I decided I needed to leave the club, but for reasons best known to the manager, they have not made me available. So I'm currently stuck in limbo and really not happy"".\nWhen asked to comment on the situation, nobody from <TeamName> was available."

"%1s has signed on with %2s for next season, hoping that this will work out for the best.  \r\n%1s put in a valiant effort last season but did not find his groove on the pitch.  ""It just didn't feel right"" he said in an interview yesterday.  This is definitely different for %1s, fans just hope that it feels right for him next season.  ""He is a good player, we don't want to see him change teams after one season with us because it doesn't feel right again"" a local supporter said.\r\nRegardless of what happens after this season, %1s is buckling down for the training ahead."

There continues to be no word on the future of <FullPlayerName>, despite wide-spread speculation that the <PreferredPos1> remains highly unsettled and resigned to a future elsewhere.\n<TeamName> officials have refused to confirm <PlayerName> is anything other than contented at the club, although the player's agent recently admitted there had been some interest from other teams. \nPublicly meanwhile, manager, <ManagerName>, is confident the uncertainty surrounding the player will have no affect on his team and is adamant that <PlayerName> is available for selection as normal.

<TeamName> officials continue to deny speculation that <PreferredPos1> <FullPlayerName> is on the verge of quitting the club and have confirmed the player was in training again today ahead of the upcoming match.\n<PlayerName>, who is believed to be homesick and finding it hard to adjust to life in the country, is rumoured to want out of the club and may consider a move home to <Nationality>.\nThe club continue to deny any move is likely and recently reminded fans that <PlayerName> is still contracted to the club, despite internet chatter that <TeamName2> remained interested.

The clash of two fierce rivals means that it's going to be a fascinating cup quarter final this year, and one where both teams will feel that they have a great chance of getting to the semi final itself. <TeamName1>'s fans are hoping that this is going to be their year to get their hands on the cup, but equally <TeamName2>'s supporters are bullish about their chances too. There is no love lost between these sets of fans, so we're probably in for a fervent atmosphere, with the majority of pundits making <TeamName3> the slight favourites to be heading to the semi final itself.

The man at the centre of the rumour mill at <TeamName> due to his alleged unwillingness to put pen to paper on any sort of new contract, has started to attract attention from other clubs. <FullPlayerName> has been silent since the news first appeared, but behind the scenes there are suggestions that a few clubs are considering testing <TeamName>'s resolve to hang on to the <PreferredPos1>. Leading the chasing pack are believed to be <TeamName2> who see <PlayerName> as someone who can improve their team. Also considering whether to make a move are <TeamName3> and <TeamName4>.

"<TeamName> and <TeamName2> are both in danger of letting their rivalry derail their chances of league glory this year, according to <ManagerName>.\nSpeaking ahead of what many are calling one of the biggest games so far this season, the <TeamName> boss said: ""I don't want to lose sight of what we are really playing for here. There are bigger prizes on offer than just bragging rights. We are trying not to let then drag us into their mindset. We are in a good position and we cannot afford to be diverted by all this derby nonsense. I think both clubs suffer because of that."""

Associates of <FullPlayerName> are hinting that the <PreferredPos1> is disillusioned with his lifestyle and is likely to seek a move to another country in the near future. The player has never fully settled despite enjoying his time at <TeamName> and now believes that the time is right to seek a move to pastures new.\nSupposedly, he has yet to talk to <ManagerName> directly about his feelings, but it's a poorly kept secret in the camp that he has struggled to cope with life in a strange country and so the news would be unlikely to come as a big surprise to the club hierarchy.

The clash of two fierce rivals means that it's going to be a fascinating cup final this year, and one where both teams will feel that they have a great chance of lifting the famous old trophy. <TeamName1>'s fans are sure that this is going to be their year to get their hands on the cup, but equally <TeamName2>'s supporters are bullish about their chances too. There is no love lost between these sets of fans, so we're probably in for a fervent atmosphere, with the majority of pundits making <TeamName3> the slight favourites to be taking the trophy home come the end of the game.

"With the <CompetitionName> Final looming over the football season, <ManagerName> has nothing but praise for his opponents <TeamName2>. ""They are an good little team, and I'm sure they will give us a good game even though we look the stronger team on paper."" he said. ""I'm sure their manager has got them nicely relaxed, not worrying too much about the massive occasion. I just hope that we can play a part in a great final and help to serve up a cracking game. I know the fans don't like each other too much, but I hope they can put that to one side and enjoy a great day out""."

"It's payback time at <TeamName> ahead of the side's squad vital game against <TeamName2> with <ManagerName> reminding his squad of their responsibility to the club and the fans.\n""I think sometimes we have to accept our responsibilities in life, "" he told the gathered press earlier this week. ""The players here are shown a great deal of faith by the club and the fans, and they need to know that there comes a time to repay that faith. They have worked very hard in training, but none of that will count for anything if we do not convert that work into a victory on the pitch."""

<TeamName> have alerted clubs to the availability of fringe player <FullPlayerName> for a loan period. <ManagerName> feels the player needs a spell of competitive football away from his parent club and having spoken to his coaching staff they decided to move him out for the time being. Currently it's not clear if the club feel he still has a future with them, so it will be interesting to see where he ends up on loan and whether talk of a permanent move surfaces. <PlayerName> hasn't been considered a key member of the squad, so this news will come as little surprise to the fans.

"<ManagerName> has reminded his lowly side that excuses are cheap as he tries to motivate them ahead of a vital match against <TeamName2>. In an unsubtle jab at some of his underachieving squad, the <TeamName> boss said: ""Only losers make excuses and I'm sick of hearing the constant moaning. The time has come to start showing our quality or we will be in real trouble. I think perhaps some of our players think they can leave it up to others to get out of our position. If they do think that, they are wrong. We are all in this together and working together is the only way out."""

"In the run up to the big <CompetitionName> tie, <ManagerName> has been speaking to the press about his opponents <TeamName2>. ""They are a quality team, there's no doubt about that."" he said to begin. ""It's quite an honour to be playing them at this stage of the competition, and with the teams quite evenly matched I suspect we might be in for a cracking cup tie. I'm sure both teams will play in the spirit of the competition even though the fans may not share a lot of love for each other, but that's the way <ManagerName2> likes the game to be played after all"" he continued."

"<TeamName2> player, <FullPlayerName2>, makes the most of his ability, according to <ManagerName>, and is a lesson to other, more talented, individuals.\nTalking at a recent press conference, <ManagerName> said: ""Sometimes, it's not about how good you are, it's about what you do with the ability you have been given. <PlayerName2> is a great example of that. He maximises his potential and some players who might be more naturally gifted than he is would do well to follow his example. He's a credit to <TeamName2> and <ManagerName2>. Even though he doesn't get them many goals..."""

"<TeamName2> will continue to struggle at the bottom of the league until they stop worrying about the opposition and concentrate on their own affairs, according to <ManagerName>.\nTalking ahead of the upcoming clash between the two lowly sides, <TeamName> boss said: ""I think their attitude is a little parochial, if I'm honest. We're not looking at this game as anything other than an opportunity to start moving up the table. They, on the other hand, seem to think beating us is all that matters. That kind of view is why they will keep struggling at the wrong end of the table."" "

The future of <FullPlayerName> is a subject of intense scrutiny currently, with the continued rumours that he wishes to leave <TeamName> in the near future. Naturally this has caused a number of other clubs to sit up and take notice. Speculation suggests that interested parties at the moment include <TeamName2> and <TeamName3>. Meanwhile fans of <TeamName4> voted <PlayerName> as the player they would most like to sign in the next transfer window in an online poll in the local media. So it seems a certainty that this story will continue to have legs as the next window approaches.

The very specific skill set required to excel as a <PreferredPos1> is seemingly proving no problem to <TeamName> youngster, <FullPlayerName>.\nStanding at %1s cm, the naturally <PreferredFoot>-footed player has caught the eye of many scouts and envious opposition coaches recently and, given the <PlayerAge>-year-old can also play elsewhere in the middle of the park, he seems certain to be in demand from a wide range of clubs. <TeamName> may want to ensure their protégé has a water-tight contract with a correspondingly massive buy-out clause aimed at scaring away would-be suitors.

"%2s have confirmed that they have decided to let %8s go to %1s in exchange for %9s and a transfer fee rumored to be around %4s.\r\nThe player has signed a %6d year deal and will be unveiled at the club's training ground later today.\r\nAs for %2s, the move sees a key player go, but welcomes one that promises to be a great addition to the squad. The %2s manager was quick to address the media regarding the move and silence any doubters, stating ""Players leaving is part of the sport, but this time we are excited to welcome %7s, a player that was in our radar for some time now."""

Already among the most popular players at <TeamName>, <FullPlayerName> is beginning to gain an even wider army of fans, following some eye-catching performances of late.
The <PreferredFoot>-footed attacking midfielder is on the verge of something special and, at only <PlayerAge>, has plenty of time on his side.
Playmakers with pace to burn and an eye for goal are obviously in high demand and it is a good bet that we haven't seen the last of this promising youngster.
At which club the boy from <Nationality> eventually fulfills his massive potential, however, remains to be seen.

Starting as they mean to go on will be crucial if <TeamName> are to make a serious run at the playoffs this season and nowhere on the field will that be more important than in attack. Forwards such as <FullPlayerName1> can help to lift the mood of the entire club with a few early-season goals, while the same can be said for midfielder, <FullPlayerName2>.
At the back, a string of clean sheets from a defence featuring <FullPlayerName3> will quickly give the side momentum that can help push them all the way to the playoffs.

"Media attempts to build up pressure on both <TeamName> and <TeamName2> ahead of their table-topping clash have been described as 'unhelpful' and 'unnecessary', according to <ManagerName>.\nThere is no need to add any additional pressure to this game. It's not helping anyone. We are playing against a wonderful side who deserve to be where they are on merit. And I think the stuff in he media is a red herring. I'm sure both sets of fans want to win this game but they also know it is no more important than any other match we play this season if we want to finish top of the heap.""  "

The ink is barely dry following %1s’s decision to sell %3s to %2s and already there is much speculation surrounding a potential replacement. It’s believed that the club is already in talks with %5s, as %1s seem to have their eyes set on %4s as the ideal candidate to fill the big hole in the squad left by %3s.\r\nThis will be an interesting transfer saga to follow. %5s will be reluctant to let the player go, but %1s will no doubt test their willingness to hold on to %4s, since it’s difficult to imagine the club reaching the end of the transfer window without a suitable replacement.

"Crazy story of the day comes from the web where one site claims that ""<TeamName> has allegedly paid a ""substantial sum"" to have the home of <FullPlayerName> completely fitted out with infra-red lamps in a bid to make the man from <Nationality> feel more at home.\n<PlayerName> has reportedly struggled to adjust to the damp climate since moving to <TeamName> and insisted on the lamps to ensure a constant temperature throughout his house.\nWhether the installation is enough to prevent <PlayerName> from forcing through a switch to a warmer country, however, remains to be seen."" "

"<FullPlayerName1>'s recent transfer to <TeamName2> has come under scrutiny due to the age of the player and the sizable transfer fee. With the <PlayerAge> year old <PreferredPos1>, sold for around <Currency1>, fans will be hoping that the player isn't a waste of money. One fan explained his concern ""I can see why the manager would want to bring him in. He's got great experience that he can pass on to the team but for that price I would have rather gone for someone a little bit younger. We need to plan for the future and I'm not sure the manager has done so with this purchase."""

"Scouting reports have left <ManagerName> with ""nothing to fear"" ahead of his team's table-topping clash with <TeamName2>.\nSpeaking to the press earlier this week, the <TeamName> boss revealed they had completed a significant amount of homework on their upcoming opponents and were confident they can handle any threat.\n""We have done a lot of preparation for this game because every win now is vital. We think we know exactly what they will try and do, and we know we can counter that. It will be a tough game but, there will be no surprises from them, as far as we're concerned."""

\n\nThings aren't looking too rosy in the defensive garden of <TeamName1> as <TeamName2> manager <ManagerName2> looks at ploughing a furrow to goal. The roots of <TeamName1>'s problems seem to stem from the under the weather <FullPlayerName1> who has managed to dig a few holes for himself in recent matches which has seen his confidence reach rock bottom. <ManagerName2> will feel that he has the tools at his disposal to carve out a victory for his team as he looks to exploit a back line that has a fair few weeds in it leading to opportunities that could bear fruit for the forwards.

In yet another amazing development in the <FullPlayerName> saga, it seems as if the player has signed for <TeamName2> for <Currency>, possibly against the wishes of <ManagerName1>. Despite being given an ultimatum to sell the player, the manager was reluctant to go ahead and it is not clear if the club took matters into their own hands and sold the player without the manager's knowledge. Quite how this will affect the position of <ManagerName1> with the club's hierarchy remains to be seen. But for now he is without his star man and must pull his team together after a frantic week.

"On the eve of the <CompetitionName> Final between <TeamName1> & <TeamName2>, <ManagerName> has been quick to talk about how much confidence he has in his team. ""It's a pretty evenly matched contest, and it's going to be a cracking day out for the fans to play in the final of a major trophy"" he began. ""But in all honesty I wouldn't swap any of my players for theirs. I've got a cracking bunch of lads, strength all over the pitch, and their team spirit is second to none. I think we'll be fine and I've every confidence that my team will handle the big occasion with no problem."" "

"<ManagerName> has once again taken leave of his senses as he placed another outlandish bid to bring in a player who was never likely to want to sign for <TeamName>.
